x: Peter Dunn, one of Syd Jarlett's School, won the 220 in 28.2, the 440 in 64.5, the 880 in 2.32, 110 Hurdles in 18.9, and the Long Jump 16ft.

Those 'terrible' Hamilton twins created an eye-opener by filling 2nd and 3rd places, beating Richard Moody into 4th place. Further back, S.White got the better of Parvez Iqbal, Russell Ward and P.Dunn after a close race.
